in_marathi.name: Jaihind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaihind हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaihind is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'jai' (victory) and 'hind' (land). It is a name of power and triumph, evoking images of brave warriors and victorious rulers. In Hindu mythology, Jaihind is the name of a legendary king who led his army to victory against all odds.
